'''Ghaina''', a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]], was one of the earliest settled colony [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Remotely situated, it was not considered important to galactic society and produced only one [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]: [[Taria Damsin]].
